name: udp-session-footprint
title: F6 UDP per-session footprint: relay receive buffer, pool sizing, adaptive idle TTL
description: Structural finding F6 of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf: each UDP session owns a relay socket with a 128 KiB kernel receive buffer by default, a ~1.6 KiB native receive-window lease from a pool whose default capacity of 256 means every session beyond 256 runs on tracked overflow allocations, and a parked async receive loop - at the 16,384-session capacity that projects to ~2 GiB of kernel receive buffers. Proposals: lower the default buffer to 32-64 KiB, size the receive-window pool from the session capacity, and give one-shot exchanges (DNS) a short adaptive idle TTL while sustained flows keep the long one.
creator: qmazon
